description: This file implements Mattermost interaction handling, including callback URL management, HMAC token generation/verification, building interactive message buttons, and an HTTP request handler for processing button click interactions.

methods.name: setInteractionCallbackUrl
methods.description: Sets the callback URL for a specific account ID.

methods.name: getInteractionCallbackUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the callback URL for a specific account ID.

methods.name: resolveInteractionCallbackPath
methods.description: Returns the URL path for Mattermost interactions for a given account.

methods.name: computeInteractionCallbackUrl
methods.description: Computes the full callback URL based on configuration and account ID.

methods.name: resolveInteractionCallbackUrl
methods.description: Returns the registered or computed callback URL for an account.

methods.name: setInteractionSecret
methods.description: Stores an HMAC secret derived from a bot token or account ID.

methods.name: getInteractionSecret
methods.description: Retrieves the stored HMAC secret for an account or token.

methods.name: generateInteractionToken
methods.description: Generates an HMAC token for a given context and account ID.

methods.name: verifyInteractionToken
methods.description: Verifies an HMAC token against a context and account ID.

methods.name: buildButtonAttachments
methods.description: Creates Mattermost message attachments with interactive buttons, including security tokens.

methods.name: buildButtonProps
methods.description: Builds message props with interactive buttons for a specific channel and account.

methods.name: createMattermostInteractionHandler
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler to process Mattermost interaction callbacks, including validation, authorization, and post-update logic.
